directPayment.channel: Charge it easy direct charging / app or QR

scope: Current official e-mobility page states 0.57 EUR/kWh for contract-free direct charging at the operator's 25 charging stations. Public charging assets were transferred to subsidiary Haller Mobilität & Wärme GmbH from 2025 while Stadtwerke Schwäbisch Hall continues billing/marketing.
policy: Do not mix HallKarte 0.49 EUR/kWh, short-term parking-card 0.60 EUR/kWh, parking fees, or roaming prices with the direct-payment CPO tariff.
